data.body: Survey checkpoint. External documentation and shipped help inspection has produced seventeen evidence-backed draft proposals. Confirmed critical accuracy defects cover DSSE signing and close behavior, import idempotency and batching, Jira project configuration, GitHub Actions identity setup, and adoption templates. Confirmed completeness defects cover omitted create and transition options, truncated MCP summaries, and missing relation or close guidance. Audience defects affect README.md, docs/user-guide.md, docs/config.md, docs/jira-sync-setup.md, docs/exit-codes.md, and packaged plan guidance. The remaining local survey covers authentication, S3, integration guides, package metadata, examples, workflow editor strings, demos, and generated provenance. Three exploration agents continue their assigned read-only shards. The packaged code-review guide will be inspected only as shipped documentation. No project files changed.
